text:
jordan: Noticed p99 reconnect surge on /v1/stream after last routing change. Many short SSE sessions ~4-6s.
li: Which routing change? last week we switched some tenants to route-by-latency bucket.
jordan: Yes, eu-lowlat group. Logs show proxy idle_poke -> client reconnect loop.
ash: Are we sending keepalive pings or letting proxy drive idle timeout?
li: Proxy does poke frames when client idle < keepalive_ms. Our new route uses aggressive idle to free sockets.
jordan: Problem: clients interpret proxy poke as terminal and reconnect immediately.
ash: Quick fix: make proxy poke use a control frame not a close, or send a small data heartbeat instead.
console-dev: I'll add a console annotation and small tile: "poke_vs_close_events" so SRE can see probe type.
ops-bot: ALERT: tenant=t-33 hit reconnect_rate_threshold at 1765436810.
li: Immediate mitigation: increase keepalive_ms for eu-lowlat from 5s->15s for 10m via feature flag.
jordan: Deploying now.
ops-bot: FLAG: keepalive_ms_override applied to eu-lowlat at 1765436822 by li.
jordan: After flip reconnects dropped ~70%. Need follow-up: change proxy poke semantics and update SDK to tolerate poke without reconnect.
console-dev: Noted. Will add UX hint in console for ops: "proxy poke expected when routing=eu-lowlat".
ash: Also add metric: reconnect.after_probe.tagged so we can attribute.
jordan: Thanks, closing after 15m stable.
